comment: A quote is not a name boundary: the lexer runs an identifier to the next stop character, so `$'` is a variable literally named `'`. jsonata 2.2.2 tokenizer: the name scan stops only on `' \t\n\r\v'` or a single-character key of `operators`, and its ast() for `$'` is {value: "'", type: "variable"} (jsntrs-5xh).
